name: Yashiro
source:
The mysterious young man pursuing Shio. [spoiler]He was actually one of the test subjects born from the same research as Shio, but their paths diverged. He deeply respects Yoshimasa and is tasked with eliminating dangerous elements who oppose Mother. [/spoiler] Currently, he is keeping an eye on Kagami, who is acting suspiciously, under the guise of being his bodyguard.
